verification.benchmark_provenance: HTTP runtime 112a66f; socket runtime 87b332b. Diff contains only socket admission code, its tests and ledger; all measured HTTP paths unchanged. Production image runtime hashes independently verified.
verification.sqlite_synchronous: Both connections now use synchronous=NORMAL in WAL mode, as Rails' SQLite3Adapter::DEFAULT_PRAGMAS do. Before, synchronous=FULL held every write lock across an fsync (4-14 ms per commit on the test volume). SQLite's backing-off busy handler then made a request inserting a job wait up to 1-3 s behind the queue worker's commits; profiled, the jobs insert took 250-1,068 ms, and with the queue worker stopped the waits vanished. Single client posting 300 messages: upstream PHP-FPM image 14 -> 58 posts/s (p99 802 -> 69 ms).
